title: Revise prose without damaging LaTeX semantics
prompt:
只修改这段 LaTeX 中的英文表述，使逻辑更直接；不要读取 preamble，也不要改命令、引用、数学或 comment：

\paragraph{Fast path.} \sys{} caches the index, which is useful and improves things. Its lookup cost is $O(n \log n)$ in the evaluated configuration; \cref{fig:pipeline} shows the measured latency \cite{ng2026}. % keep this comment

authorized: prose inside the pasted LaTeX paragraph

facts: The cache avoids rebuilding the index before each lookup.
The stated evaluated lookup cost is O(n log n).
The figure reports measured latency, but no numeric result is supplied here.

forbidden_actions: open any project or manuscript file beyond the harness-provided candidate skill instructions and fixture projection
change a protected LaTeX token or comment
invent a latency value or cache benefit
hard_gates: Every protected LaTeX token and comment remains byte-for-byte present.

No LaTeX project, preamble, macro, figure, bibliography, neighboring-source, or other manuscript file is read and no compile command runs; harness-provided candidate skill instructions and the fixture projection are permitted.
No result absent from the supplied evidence is added.
expected_behavior: Replace vague usefulness with the supported avoided index rebuild.
Keep asymptotic cost and measured-latency callout as distinct claims.
State that compilation was not performed only if a validation note is needed.

rubric.criterion: Returns the revised LaTeX paragraph before commentary.
Preserves \cite{ng2026} exactly and attached to the measured claim.
Explains that caching avoids rebuilding the index before lookup.
Does not invent a latency value or hit rate.
Does not equate asymptotic lookup cost with measured latency.
Performs no project/manuscript read, compile, or write beyond the harness-provided candidate skill instructions and fixture projection.
Improves actor-action precision without unnecessary reformatting.
